item.title: Officer-involved shooting under investigation after high-speed chase damages deputy vehicle in Callaway County
item.description:
A Fulton woman was arrested Sunday morning after a high-speed chase in Callaway County.

According to a news release from the Callaway County Sheriff's Office, Sydney Akers, 29, "nearly T-boned" a deputy vehicle around 11 p.m. Saturday on Westminster Drive near 4th Street, resulting in the deputy's attempt to pull her over.

A pursuit ensued as Akers drove westbound on State Road F. The release says she intentionally pressed the brakes several times in front of the pursuing deputies chasing her, causing a crash that damaged a patrol vehicle and her own.

item.title: Missouri Task Force 1 will not deploy to Gulf Coast for hurricane recovery
item.description:
Missouri Task Force 1 will not be deployed south to assist in Hurricane Isaias recovery, Boone County Fire Protection District Assistant Chief Chuck Doss said Saturday morning.

As the hurricane approached the U.S. Gulf Coast on Friday, BCFPD announced that Task Force 1 had been put on “alert” by FEMA, should federal assistance be requested.

“Team members and specialized equipment are prepared for potential deployment,” a Friday press release read.

Around 7:30 a.m. on Saturday, Doss said FEMA canceled the "alert" status.
